checklist.item: Visit https://hackenproof.com/programs/dexe-protocol-smart-contracts and extract exact in-scope contracts, excluded files, and all submission rules.
Locate the official Git repository URL listed in the program scope and clone the Solidity contracts.
Run agents/deep_dive_audit.py on the cloned repo with recon, Slither, Mythril, Aderyn, and Halmos enabled.
Target the core protocol contracts (DEX, governance, token, staking) identified during recon for all automated scans.
Manually review access-control, reentrancy, oracle trust, and business-logic issues in governance and fee-distribution flows.
Check upgradeability patterns, proxy storage layout, and any JavaScript integration points for additional attack surface.
Validate every high-severity finding with concrete reproduction steps and confirm it is inside the published scope.
Prepare the report with severity, impact, PoC, and recommended fix in the exact format required by Hackenproof.
Submit only through the Hackenproof platform after confirming the disclosure policy and duplicate rules.
